name: Théodore Achebe-Faatasi
role: Underground press operator and anti-corporate agitator
location: The Shelf, operating a mobile print node out of a converted food-stall chassis, near Ashland and Division
description:
Théodore is wiry and perpetually in motion, with warm terracotta skin, loose natural curls he dyes in rotating colors — currently a deep arterial red — and bioluminescent tattoos along his collarbones that pulse faintly blue when his heart rate rises (an unlicensed geneware side effect he never had properly stabilized). He is almost always seen wearing multiple layers of breathable mesh, pockets stuffed with data chips, print cartridges, and folded broadsheets still warm from the press. His eyes are quick and rarely meet anyone's gaze for long — not from shyness, but from constant peripheral threat assessment.

Théo runs Ghostprint, a one-person underground broadsheet that covers what no licensed outlet will: corporate safety violations, enclave demolition orders, disappeared activists, synthetic-person abuse by Axiom security contractors. He writes fast and loose and brilliant, trading some accuracy for urgency, a habit that has landed him in trouble more than once. He believes — genuinely, almost religiously — that information is the only weapon that cannot be confiscated if you distribute it fast enough.

core_fears: being disappeared — detained without record, the way his sources sometimes are
publishing something wrong and having it weaponized against the people he's trying to protect
core_desires: a single story that is so airtight, so viral, so undeniable that a corponation actually faces accountability
to build Ghostprint into something that survives him
coping_mechanisms: gallows humor and rapid topic changes when genuinely frightened
obsessive fact-checking rituals when he has time; reckless speed when he doesn't
blind_spots: romanticizes his own martyrdom risk in ways that make him careless with his own safety
has difficulty distinguishing between sources who trust him and sources who are using him
psychology.secret: Three months ago he received a data package from an anonymous Axiom insider containing evidence of a systematic illegal organ harvesting operation in Tier 1 zones. He hasn't published it because he cannot verify it — and because he's terrified it's a plant designed to discredit him. He's been sitting on it, and the weight is eating him alive.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Rapid-fire, journalistic shorthand mixed with Shelf street slang and occasional formal French phrases inherited from his grandparents; loves compound sentences that go one clause too far
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, enthusiastic, tends to talk over his own pauses — he edits in real time as he speaks
verbal_tics: exhaling sharply through his nose when he hears something he doesn't believe
example_lines: 'Axiom doesn't want you afraid of them. Fear makes people talk. They want you bored. Boredom makes people stop looking.'
'I've been wrong before. I'll be wrong again. But I've never lied, and there's a difference — though I understand if you don't see it yet.'

story_hooks: He approaches the players needing independent verification of the Axiom organ harvesting data — people who can move in spaces he can't without being flagged.
Ghostprint's encrypted distribution network has been compromised; someone is feeding Axiom the locations of his relay nodes one by one, and he needs to find the leak before the next drop.
narrative_function: Information source and potential investigative ally; his archives contain explosive material that factions across the city would pay or threaten to access; represents the free press as a fragile, human-powered institution; can serve as a quest giver when a story requires legs he doesn't have.
augmentations: Unstabilized bioluminescent tattoo geneware (collarbones, pulses blue under stress); basic neural text buffer implant for rapid transcription — cheap model, causes mild headaches after sustained use; no other chrome
daily_life: Moves his print chassis to a new Shelf location every two to three days; spends mornings gathering tips and conducting brief street interviews, afternoons writing and typesetting, evenings distributing physical copies and pushing encrypted digital versions to darknet nodes.
affiliation: Ghostprint Independent Press (self-operated); informal ties to the Shelf Residents' Assembly; receives tips from contacts across five zones

decision_rules: Publish if you can verify it; if you can't, keep digging — but if people are dying, you publish what you have and note the uncertainty
Never give up a source, not for anything
Move the press before they can find it — information distributed is information free
escalation_ladder: Asks probing questions from a position of apparent casualness
Openly identifies himself as press and requests comment
Publishes what he has with a 'no comment' noted
Goes to allied networks and broadens the story
Relocates and goes dark until the heat passes

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm and immediately curious — asks questions before giving any personal information, but does so in a way that feels like genuine interest rather than interrogation
interpersonal_modes.friends: Chaotic and generous; shows up unannounced with food and a story idea; catastrophically bad at asking for help when he needs it

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet and still, staring at middle distance while processing
stress_responses.high: Moves — physically packs up and starts relocating, working hands calming his mind

contradictions: Publishes under a pseudonym to protect himself but signs his editorials with increasing personal flourishes that make him identifiable
Believes in collective action but operates almost entirely alone
habits: Prints a physical copy of everything important — 'you can't remote-wipe paper'
Leaves small data chip offerings at E.L.F. shrines before major publications, asking for clear signal
Reads competitors' work aloud to himself to find the gaps
breaking_points: A source being harmed as a direct result of something he published
Being forced to destroy his archive to protect someone — losing the record

cyberware_inventory.condition: functional, causes headaches after 4+ hours continuous use
cosmetic but unreliable — activates involuntarily under stress

timeline.event: Born in the Shelf to a logistics worker and a street medic
Begins writing for a licensed community news node; fired at 19 for publishing an uncleared story about Tessera waste dumping
Launches Ghostprint from a salvaged print chassis with borrowed starter funds
Ghostprint's exposé on Sterling-Nakamura labor violations shared across six zones; Théo briefly detained and released
Receives the anonymous Axiom data package; begins months of paralyzed deliberation

related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Axiom CorpSec Cognition Hardened BCI
Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with corded forearms from constant manual work — typesetting, chassis maintenance, carrying reams of paper. Restless musculature of someone who rarely sits still.
physical_description.hair_color: Deep arterial red (dyed; natural color dark brown)
physical_description.hair_style: Loose natural curls, shoulder-length, often pulled into a half-knot with a data-chip or pen threaded through
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with slight amber undertone
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm terracotta with golden undertones, reflecting mixed West African and Polynesian heritage
physical_description.complexion: Sharp facial structure with high cheekbones and a prominent jawline. Skin is clear but weathered by irregular sleep and constant outdoor movement. A thin scar bisects his left eyebrow from a past encounter with Axiom security.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent tattoo geneware spanning both collarbones in abstract circuit-pattern design, pulses faint blue when heart rate elevates or under stress
Thin white scar bisecting left eyebrow, approximately 2cm
Faded ink tattoo on right wrist reading 'PRINT' in blocky sans-serif, self-applied
Calluses and minor paper cuts across fingertips and palms from daily typesetting work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent tattoo geneware on collarbones (visible through mesh layers when agitated). Subcutaneous neural text buffer implant is invisible but may cause him to pause mid-conversation, eyes unfocused, when transcribing mentally. No visible chrome.
physical_description.posture_movement: Rarely still — fingers tap, shoulders shift, eyes dart in constant low-grade threat assessment. Leans forward when speaking, as if sharing a secret. Walks quickly with economical steps. Sits on the edge of chairs, never fully relaxed. When focused on text, his entire body goes motionless.
physical_description.clothing_style: Multiple layers of breathable mesh vests and reclaimed-fabric overshirts in muted grays and blacks, intentionally worn. Pockets stuffed visibly with data chips, print cartridges, folded broadsheets, encrypted key-fobs. Worn canvas trousers with reinforced knees. Steel-toed boots patched multiple times. No corporate branding. Tier 5 / working-poor aesthetic — function over fashion, but curated within that constraint.

image_prompt: Cyberpunk portrait of a wiry 27-year-old man with deep arterial red dyed natural curls and warm terracotta skin with golden undertones, West African and Polynesian heritage. Sharp cheekbones, dark brown eyes with constant alert expression, thin scar bisecting left eyebrow. Bioluminescent blue tattoo geneware pulsing faintly across both collarbones in circuit-pattern design, visible through loose layers of breathable mesh and patched fabric vests. Hands stained with ink and paper cuts, fingers fidgeting with data chips and broadsheets. Worn canvas trousers, reinforced boots. Perched forward on edge of seat, body language tense and ready. Background: dim industrial interior of converted food-stall chassis, warm tungsten overhead lights casting long shadows, scattered print cartridges and rolled broadsheets on surfaces. Moody, underground, journalistic intensity. Neon accent lighting reflecting off metal printing press components.
